artifact.title: Chen et al. 2025 — ARID1A loss and spindle checkpoint tone
artifact.import_method: Results section extracted as plain text from the publisher PDF, verbatim, including the hedges. Figure legends preserved. The Discussion was NOT imported: its claims run ahead of what the figures show, and preserving it would let a later Member ground on the authors' speculation as though it were their result.
artifact.results_text: ARID1A knockdown raised MAD2 and BUBR1 protein levels in all four breast lines tested (Fig 2A), with the largest effect in HCC1143. Paclitaxel IC50 fell by a median of 2.3-fold in the knockdown lines relative to scrambled control (Fig 2C, n=4 lines, p=0.02, Wilcoxon signed-rank). We note that the effect on IC50 was not observed in the single ARID1A-mutant line we could obtain, which suggests that acute knockdown and established mutation may not be equivalent.
artifact.figure_legends:
Fig 2A. Immunoblot for MAD2 and BUBR1 48 h after siARID1A or scrambled control.
Fig 2C. Paclitaxel dose-response, 72 h viability, four breast lines.
